marketing_wrapper: 01 is pure marketing illustration (two birbs hugging on hills under a sky, with trophy/heart bubbles). 02–06 place a light-grey rounded frame (no device bezel detail) on a #a3dfff sky backdrop with a heavy dark-blue caption in the top ~22%; the frame (~70%) holds real UI: Goal Buddies checklist, a Valentine send sheet, the home adventure + goals list, a buddy celebration sheet, and self-care progress.

typography.display: Rounded-terminal geometric sans in bold/black for captions and in-app headings (3 goals left today!, You & Sam are now Goal Buddies!); closely resembles Rubik, unsure
typography.numerals: rounded; small bold energy counts (5 ⚡), a countdown 'back in 7:36'
typography.weights: Bold for goal names and titles, regular grey for secondary text and empty-state prompts
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; small all-caps tracked section labels (START THE DAY, YOU / SAM, TO)

palette.accent_strategy: Brand-flooded scenes over neutral UI: illustrated scene backgrounds change per context (green meadow, pink Valentine, NYC skyline at dusk) while list cards stay white. Small accents are per-person (purple for one buddy, blue for the other) and per-area (blue nutrition, yellow movement, green productivity, orange self-kindness); yellow lightning for energy.
palette.source: palette.json 02/04: #7bb761 / #81be81 = grass scene; 03: #e597bc / #e06ca9 = Valentine sheet; 05/06: #ffffff / #f3f4f4 = sheets and page; #a3dfff ~20% = marketing sky; 05 #2f353e = dark text/scene. Purple CTA and area colours are visual estimates.

shape.radius_language: large: ~18pt list cards, ~24pt sheets, pill buttons with a darker bottom lip (chunky pressable look), circular checkmarks and avatar badges, speech bubbles with tails
shape.borders_shadows: Buttons and check tiles have a solid 2–3pt darker bottom edge (Duolingo-style faux 3D); cards have a thin grey outline; characters cast soft oval ground shadows
shape.materials: Flat vector illustration with soft cheek blush and simple shading; confetti particles; no glass

density: medium: illustrated scene takes the top ~40%, then roomy rows (~56pt) of goal cards with icon tile, name, energy value and a large check button
layout: Home: illustrated scene with the pet (adventure state) at top, a status card with a dotted progress path and countdown, '3 goals left today!' header, then sectioned goal cards (START THE DAY) each with emoji icon, label, ⚡ reward and a check button. Other screens are bottom sheets over the scene.
navigation: No tab bar visible in these frames. Bottom sheets with grab handles and circular close (×) buttons; back chevron over the scene; full-width pill CTAs at the bottom (Send a Valentine!, Send encouragement).
imagery_and_icons: Flat vector characters (the birbs) with expressive poses and speech bubbles; Apple-style emoji as goal icons (cup with straw, giraffe, broccoli, sunflower, toothbrush) and themed message icons; drawn circular area icons (apple, shoe, target, sunflower).
signature_visual_move: Each screen opens on an illustrated scene where the user's birb acts out the current state (adventuring, cheering, watering a heart flower) above a plain checklist.
tells_present: Emoji as icons (goal icons are system emoji)
Streak/energy counter with a lightning glyph (⚡ per goal)

direction_fit.why: The pet is the motivator on every screen, with speech-bubble encouragement ('Nourish what matters to you, cheep!'), and the illustration hand is consistent. The checklist UI is conventional and chunky, like Duolingo.

notes: Emoji as goal icons is a deliberate product choice here (user-picked goals), but it's the clearest emoji-icon case in the batch. The ⚡ energy is a currency rather than a streak, so it is only a near-match for the streak tell.
